newsitem.title: USA: Cryolife, Bayer end licensing talks.
newsitem.headline: Cryolife, Bayer end licensing talks.

text.p: CryoLife Inc said on Friday that discussions with Bayer Corp regarding a worldwide license for CryolLife's patented fibrin-based bioadhesive technology had ended without agreement for a license.

Under a prior agreement, Bayer paid CryoLife $250,000 for the exclusive right to negotiate with CryoLife for a worldwide license to "FibRx" technology. That exclusive negotiation agreement has now expired, said CryoLife in a statement.
The company said it was available to discuss partnerships and license agreements for the technology with other interested parties.
